description: Put your knowledge to the test and flex your mental muscles at our Trivia Night Fundraiser for Ricky Rivard for County Board! Join us for an evening of friendly competition, laughter, and brain teasers on July 25th at 5 pm at Aurelio’s Pizza in Geneva. Gather your smartest friends and form a team
title: Trivia Night Fundraiser — Ricky Rivard | Putting People First
